findings.summary: Every toast, errors included, disappears after 6 s with no close button, no pause on hover or focus and no way to extend, so failure messages for save, delete, toggle and decrypt can vanish before they are read.
findings.fix: Keep error and warning toasts until dismissed (add a labelled Close button), pause the timer on hover and focus, and keep the 6 s auto-dismiss only for success. Alternatively, show failures in the persistent StatusBanner above the editor (AppChrome.jsx:126).
findings.evidence: notify(message, type, duration = 6000) ... window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), duration); the longest message (notification.decryptRefused, notification.undecryptableValues) is over 100 characters.

findings.summary: The overwrite confirmation on Import checks only the files currently listed; with 'Search in content' on, that list holds only matches, so importing over an existing configuration overwrites it on the server without any confirmation.
findings.fix: Check for an existing file against the server (a file(name:) query, or the unfiltered list) rather than the filtered 'files' state, before calling processUpload. Apply the same check to the conflicting .disabled twin that is deleted at line 237-242.
findings.evidence: const existing = files.find(f => f.name === baseName || ...); files comes from fetchFiles(searchTerm, true) (useOsgiConfigs.ts:224-228), which queries files(search:) (osgiService.ts:155-159).

findings.summary: The import conflict dialog asks 'What do you want to do?' and the code passes a Rename choice, but ModalDialog never renders otherLabel/onOther, so only Cancel and Overwrite appear and the safer option promised by the wording is missing.
findings.fix: Render a third footer button when config.otherLabel is set (calling onClose then config.onOther), so 'Rename' is available; or, if renaming is dropped, change modal.conflict.message to 'The file {{name}} already exists. Overwrite it?'.
findings.evidence: useFileActions.ts:266-284 sets otherLabel: t('modal.conflict.rename') and onOther; Dialogs.jsx:502-525 renders only cancelLabel and confirmLabel.

findings.summary: Import overwrites a configuration without the review-before-save diff used by Save, and when the existing file is the .disabled twin it also deletes that file and makes the configuration active, which the conflict message does not say.
findings.fix: Route an import over an existing file through the DiffModal (old content vs uploaded content), and state the side effect in the conflict message, e.g. 'Importing replaces {{name}}. The configuration will be enabled because the imported file is not .disabled.'
findings.evidence: await osgiService.save(payload); ... if (existingConflict) { await osgiService.delete(existingConflict.name); }

findings.summary: The 'Manual filename' field states the allowed extensions nowhere before submission (only an example in the placeholder); the rule '.cfg, .yml, .cfg.disabled or .yml.disabled' appears only in an error dialog after Create.
findings.fix: Add persistent helper text under the field, e.g. 'End the name with .cfg or .yml. Add .disabled to create it disabled.', associate it with aria-describedby, and validate inline so Create stays disabled until the extension is valid.
findings.evidence: placeholder={t('modal.create.manualPlaceholder')} ('e.g. org.test.config.cfg'); the rule is in modal.error.invalidExtension, shown by useFileActions.ts:119-131 after the dialog closed.

findings.summary: The create dialog closes before the file name is validated or created, and its state is reset, so after an invalid extension or a server error the administrator must click New again and retype the name.
findings.fix: Validate the extension inside the dialog before closing, and keep the dialog open with the typed value on a server error (await onConfirm, close only on success, show the error inline). Do not clear manualFilename when a Metatype card is chosen (lines 389 and 429).
findings.evidence: handleConfirm: onClose(); ... config.onConfirm(confirmPayload). useEffect([config]) resets manualFilename, filterValue, selections (lines 127-135); setManualFilename('') on card click (389, 429).

findings.summary: The tree editor's 'Add Property' prompt closes before the duplicate check; a duplicate name opens a separate error dialog and the administrator must start again and retype the name.
findings.fix: Check the name against existing keys inside the prompt and show the error under the input without closing it, keeping the typed value.
findings.evidence: onConfirm: (key) => { const onError = msg => setTimeout(() => setModalConfig({... message: msg ...}), 100); addProperty(path, key, onError); }

findings.summary: The delete-file confirmation's action button reads only 'OK' and the message does not say the file is permanently removed from the server; the delete-property confirmation (useOsgiConfigs.ts:670) also falls back to 'OK'.
findings.fix: Pass confirmLabel: 'Delete file' (and 'Delete property'), and reword modal.deleteFile.message to 'Delete {{name}} from the server? This cannot be undone. Download it first if you may need it again.'
findings.evidence: setModalConfig({type:'confirm', severity:'warning', title, message}) with no confirmLabel, so Dialogs.jsx:519 renders t('modal.ok') = 'OK'; en.json:71 'Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?'

findings.summary: The header button that discards every unsaved edit in the file is labelled 'Cancel', the same word used to dismiss dialogs, so its effect (revert the file to its saved state) is not described.
findings.fix: Label it 'Discard changes' (matching modal.unsaved.confirm 'Discard Changes') or 'Revert', with tooltip 'Reload the saved version and discard your edits'.
findings.evidence: <ActionButton dataCy="cancel-config-button" tooltip={t('modal.cancel')} label={t('modal.cancel')} onClick={onCancel} />

findings.summary: The encryption checkbox in each .cfg row sits under a column titled only 'Security', so nothing says that ticking it stores the value as ENC(...) on save.
findings.fix: Rename the column 'Encrypted' (en.json editor.header.security) and give each checkbox a label and tooltip such as 'Encrypt the value of {{key}} when saving'.
findings.evidence: Header t('editor.header.security') = 'Security'; cell title='Security'; <Checkbox checked={isEncrypted} onChange=... /> with no label (lines 777-786).

findings.summary: In 'Create new configuration' the tabs 'Manual', 'Configuration' and 'Factory' and the heading 'Filter' do not say what each path creates, and 'Created file:' labels a file that does not exist yet.
findings.fix: Use descriptive labels: 'Empty file', 'From Metatype', 'Factory instance'; 'Filter available configurations'; and 'File to create:' instead of 'Created file:' (en.json modal.create.tabs.*, filterLabel, suggestedFilename).
findings.evidence: en.json:42-47 filterLabel 'Filter', tabs 'Manual' / 'Configuration' / 'Factory'; en.json:53 suggestedFilename 'Created file'.

findings.summary: Arrow keys in the file list immediately open the next file, replacing the editor, toolbar and banners (and opening a discard-changes dialog on each press when edits are unsaved), without any instruction that arrows open files.
findings.fix: Let arrow keys move focus only and open a file on Enter or Space (or click); if selection must follow focus, add a visible hint above the list, e.g. 'Use Arrow keys to move, Enter to open'.
findings.evidence: if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); handleFileClick(processedFiles[nextIndex]); } on a tabIndex=0 div with no role or instructions (lines 129-133).

findings.summary: When Metatype help is available, pressing Enter opens the suggestion list on the new empty line, so a second Enter inserts the first suggested property instead of another blank line.
findings.fix: Do not open suggestions automatically on newline (users can press Ctrl+Space), or set acceptSuggestionOnEnter: 'off' (or 'smart') in the editor options so Enter keeps inserting a line.
findings.evidence: editor.onDidChangeModelContent(event => { if (... change.text.includes('\n')) ... editor.trigger('metatype','editor.action.triggerSuggest', {}) }); no acceptSuggestionOnEnter option is set.

findings.summary: The raw editor's Encrypt and Decrypt tooltips promise to act on the selection, but both act on the value of the cursor's line; Encrypt silently does nothing when that line has no value or is already encrypted.
findings.fix: Reword tooltips to 'Encrypt the value on the cursor's line' and 'Decrypt the ENC(...) value on the cursor's line' (en.json tooltip.encryptSelection, tooltip.decryptSelection), and show a warning toast when Encrypt finds nothing to encrypt, as Decrypt already does.
findings.evidence: en.json:250 'Encrypt current line value or selection', en.json:251 'Decrypt selected text'; MonacoEditor.jsx:1209-1218 'if (!match) return; if (!valuePart) return; if (valueTrimmed.startsWith("ENC(")) return;'

findings.summary: Nothing visible says the open file has unsaved changes; the only cue is that Save and Cancel become enabled, so administrators must remember whether they edited the file. The 'app.unsaved' label exists but is never used.
findings.fix: Show an 'Unsaved changes' chip next to the file name when hasUnsaved is true, using t('app.unsaved'), and mark the file's row in the sidebar.
findings.evidence: isSaveDisabled = !hasUnsaved || ...; en.json:17 "unsaved": "Unsaved Changes" has no reference in src/javascript.

findings.summary: Unsaved edits are guarded for in-app actions but not when leaving the page: a reload, a click in the Jahia admin menu, or a sign-in after an expired session discards them with no warning.
findings.fix: Register a beforeunload handler while hasUnsaved is true, and guard the Jahia route change if the app shell provides a hook for it.
findings.evidence: runWithUnsavedConfirmation covers file switch, refresh, create, import, toggle and mark-as-default; no beforeunload handler exists under src/javascript/osgiConfigManager.

findings.summary: The same close function is a named 'Cancel' button in ModalDialog but an unnamed clickable icon in the review and Add Property dialogs, and the X icon also deletes rows in the .cfg editor while file delete uses a trash icon.
findings.fix: Use one Close button (Moonstone Button, icon Close, aria-label 'Close') in all three dialogs, and use the Delete icon with label 'Delete property' for row deletion (CfgEditor.jsx:792-803).
findings.evidence:
Dialogs.jsx:285-291 Button aria-label={t('modal.cancel')}; DiffModal.tsx:145-150 and CfgMetatypePropertyDialog.jsx:112-114
; CfgEditor.jsx:794 icon={} for delete.

findings.summary: Terms vary for one thing: 'Import' button vs 'Upload' in its tooltip, toast and rename dialog; menu label 'OSGi Config Manager' vs title 'OSGi Configurations Manager'; and 'Add Property' names two different actions.
findings.fix: Pick one verb (for example 'Import') for app.import, tooltip.uploadFile, notification.uploadSuccess and modal.rename.title; align label with app.title; and name the raw editor's button 'Browse Metatype properties'.
findings.evidence: en.json:2 'OSGi Config Manager', :4 'OSGi Configurations Manager', :6 'Import', :25 'Uploaded {{name}}', :116 'Rename uploaded file', :232 'Upload configuration file'; :134-135 both 'Add Property'.

findings.summary: Some English labels do not say what they act on or set: 'Hide' (Metatype panel), 'Toggle Comments' and 'Toggle Empty Lines' (state shown only by an eye icon), 'Type here...', and 'Format YAML code' also on .cfg files.
findings.fix: Use 'Hide available properties', 'Show comments'/'Hide comments' and 'Show empty lines'/'Hide empty lines' (with aria-pressed), a specific placeholder or none, and tooltip 'Format the file'.
findings.evidence: en.json:138 'Hide', :146-147 'Toggle Comments' / 'Toggle Empty Lines', :120 'Type here...', :247 'Format YAML code'; CfgEditor.jsx:157-172 icon={showComments ? <Visibility/> : <Hidden/>}.

findings.summary: Error messages name the operation and append raw server text but do not suggest a next step; a failed Save shows the bare server message, and 'Toggled status for {{name}}' does not say whether the file is now enabled or disabled.
findings.fix: Use the 'Error saving: {{error}}' key on the Save path, add a recovery hint (e.g. 'Your changes are still in the editor. Try again or download the file.'), and split the toggle toast into '{{name}} enabled' / '{{name}} disabled'.
findings.evidence: toastError(e.message); en.json:21 'Toggled status for {{name}}'; en.json:98-102 'Error saving: {{error}}' etc.

findings.summary: Deleting a comment or empty line asks 'Are you sure you want to delete Add Comment?' (or 'Add Empty Line') because the button labels are reused as the item's name.
findings.fix: Use dedicated strings, e.g. 'Delete this comment?' and 'Delete this empty line?', instead of editor.button.addComment / addEmptyLine.
findings.evidence: displayName = t('editor.button.addComment') / t('editor.button.addEmptyLine'); message t('modal.deleteProp.message', {name: displayName}).

findings.summary: The duplicate-keys alert shows two buttons, 'Cancel' and 'OK', that do the same thing, which suggests a choice that does not exist.
findings.fix: Pass confirmLabel: null and cancelLabel: t('modal.ok') as the other error alerts do (useOsgiConfigs.ts:316-323).
findings.evidence: setModalConfig({type: 'alert', title, message}); Dialogs.jsx:503-524 renders cancelLabel || 'Cancel' and confirmLabel || 'OK'.

findings.summary: Save is disabled while the YAML or raw content is invalid, and 'Mark as Default' is disabled for module files, with no text near the button saying why; the 'invalid YAML' explanation in handleSave cannot be reached.
findings.fix: Show an inline message beside Save when the content is invalid ('Fix the errors marked in the editor to save') and a reason under Mark as Default when it is unavailable, instead of relying on tooltips on disabled buttons.
findings.evidence: disabled={isSaveDisabled} with isSaveDisabled = !hasUnsaved || ((isRawMode || isYamlFile) && !isYamlValid); SelectedFileToolbar.jsx:82 disabled={!canMarkAsDefault}; useOsgiConfigs.ts:315-325.

findings.summary: Keyboard reordering stays active while the filter is on or comments and empty lines are hidden, so Arrow Up/Down swaps the row with a hidden one: the visible row seems not to move while hidden lines are reordered.
findings.fix: Disable the reorder handle while filtering (as the drag zone already is), and when rows are hidden move the entry past the previous or next visible row.
findings.evidence: onKeyDown: if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && index > 0) handleReorder(index, index - 1); there is no check for 'filtering', showComments or showEmptyLines.

passed: 3.3.4 Save: every save goes through a review-before-save diff that must be confirmed (useOsgiConfigs.ts:382-395, DiffModal.tsx), with secrets masked.
3.3.4 Disable and Mark as Default ask for confirmation, with a specific action label ('Disable', 'Mark as Default') (useFileActions.ts:59-69, 93-101).
3.3.4 Encryption: the visual-mode checkbox and the raw Encrypt button only change the editor, so the change is reviewed in the save diff before it reaches the server.
3.3.4 Unsaved edits are guarded before switching file, refreshing, creating, importing, toggling and marking as default ('Discard Changes' / 'Keep Editing', index.jsx:110-202).

3.3.7 Create: the filter text is kept when switching between the Configuration and Factory tabs; factory instance identifiers already in use are flagged live before submission (Dialogs.jsx:200-207, 458-462).
3.2.1 On Focus: focusing a .cfg input only highlights its row; no focus handler opens dialogs, navigates or submits.
3.2.2 On Input: the 'Search in content' switch, the encryption checkbox and the show/hide-secrets buttons change only the current view or a pending edit.

3.2.3 Consistent Navigation: a single admin route; the header toolbar (New, Import, Refresh) and the file toolbar (Disable/Enable, Mark as Default, Download, Delete) keep the same order and position for every file.
2.4.6 Page title h1 'OSGi Configurations Manager', dialog titles ('Review Changes: {{name}}', 'Disable configuration', 'Unsaved Changes') and the unsaved-changes buttons are descriptive.
2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: the only animation is the loading spinner, which appears only while data loads.
Locale parity: all six locale files have the same 193 keys, so no label falls back to a raw key.
notes: 2.2.1 session: the session timeout is Jahia's, not the module's. The module has no expiry warning or extension, and a request after expiry fails with a 6 s error toast (COG-001), then signing in again loses edits (COG-016). Check the platform's session length and warning in the running instance.
3.2.6 Consistent Help: N/A. The app offers no help mechanism (contact, help link or chat), so nothing has to stay in the same place.
3.3.8 Accessible Authentication: N/A. The module has no sign-in step; authentication is Jahia's.

3.2.2 editor mode: choosing 'Raw Edit' / 'Visual Edit' in the dropdown replaces the editor straight away. The user chose it and the option is labelled, so it is not flagged, but tooltip.modeRaw and tooltip.modeVisual are unused and could tell users the mode is remembered.
3.2.2 create dialog: choosing a factory card moves focus into the identifier field (autoFocus, Dialogs.jsx:447). This is a user click and the field is the next step, so it is not flagged.

Hand-off to forms and aria specialists: visible labels are Typography that is not linked to its input (Dialogs.jsx:334-344, 350-359, 442-452); the deep-search Switch has no accessible name (FileSidebar.jsx:117-121); CreateOptionCard is a clickable div with no keyboard access (Dialogs.jsx:90-115); table header cells are TableBodyCell inside thead (CfgEditor.jsx:178-205).
Hand-off to the live-region controller: the toast Paper (useToast.tsx:77-97) has no role=status/alert, so screen readers may not announce the outcome of any action.

Unused English keys that point to missing UI: app.unsaved, tooltip.modeRaw, tooltip.modeVisual, configState.badgeCompact.*, sidebar.on/off, modal.create.or. The sidebar shows a disabled file only by strikethrough and a grey bar (FileSidebar.jsx:158, 173); that is a 1.4.1/1.3.1 question for the visual specialist.

AAA/COGA advisory, not flagged one by one: the audience is server administrators, so OSGi terms (PID, Metatype, factory, ENC(...)) are fine as domain vocabulary. 'materialized' (modal.create.message) and 'Redo reversed change' (tooltip.redo) could be plainer.
Editor.jsx (tree editor) only renders for files that are neither .cfg nor .yml, which the UI cannot create; it was reviewed lightly (COG-007).
